    AI Overview
    Purdue defeated Texas 79-77 in a 2026 Sweet 16 thriller, led by Trey Kaufman-Renn's 20 points and 8 rebounds. Tramon Mark scored a team-high 29 points for Texas in the loss. Purdue advanced to the Elite Eight, with crucial contributions from Fletcher Loyer (18 pts) and Braden Smith (16 pts, 5 ast). 
    Purdue Boilermakers Top Stats 
    Trey Kaufman-Renn: 20 PTS, 8 REB, 8/10 FG 
    Fletcher Loyer: 18 PTS, 6/13 FG 
    Braden Smith: 16 PTS, 5 AST, 2 STL 
    Oscar Cluff: 11 PTS, 4/7 FG 
    Texas Longhorns Top Stats 
    • Tramon Mark: 29 PTS, 11/15 FG, 2/4 FT
    • Dailyn Swain: 9 REB, 5 AST
    • Nic Codie: 1 STL 
    Matchup Key Details 
    • Final Score: Purdue 79, Texas 77
    • Key Run: Purdue's Kaufman-Renn hit his first seven shots, helping the Boilermakers secure a 30-8 record and a spot in the Elite Eight.
    • Turning Point: Dailyn Swain tied the game for Texas with a driving layup and free throw with 11.9 seconds left, but Purdue ultimately secured the win.
    • Shooting: Texas shot 44% from deep (11-of-25), while Purdue shot 75% from the free throw line (15-of-20).
